other_conditions: Applicant must be an Indian citizen
Must possess a PhD/M.D/M.S degree from a recognised university or have submitted the thesis and be awaiting award
Only one fellowship can be availed in a career
Mentor must hold a regular academic/research position in a recognised Indian institution and have a Ph.D. in Science or Engineering
Mentor cannot supervise more than two SERB NPDF fellows simultaneously
Fellow cannot work with the Ph.D. guide/co‑guide and cannot be placed in the same department/institution where the degree was earned
Fellowship is tenable only in India at recognised academic, national laboratory or R&D institutions
Applicants must not hold any other fellowship from any Government or Non‑Government source during the tenure
Age relaxation of 5 years for candidates belonging to SC, ST, OBC, physically challenged and women
benefits_summary: Monthly fellowship of ₹55,000 (₹35,000 for candidates awaiting degree award) plus an annual research grant of ₹2,00,000 and overheads of ₹1,00,000.
documents_required: Research proposal detailing objectives, methodology and work plan (PDF, max 10 MB)
